limits: Controlled pixels and metadata were written as actual Zarr files; these are not independently acquired plate data.
Two positions and 128 frames exercise file readers, non-contiguous labels and unequal ROI counts, not the representative concurrency or storage workload.
The first five-ROI two-process configuration did not activate the CCG process pool; the separate 12/14 ROI recording does.
Summed RSS can double-count shared pages and miss peaks; short benchmark stages may have no sample.
Exact comparisons exclude the four stochastic CCG significance fields listed in the complete report.
Production source and installed wheel are unchanged; no GUI gate or cached-default promotion occurred.
